github_ci.production_reproduction: dist/index.html and every dist/assets file compared byte-for-byte against staged GitHub Pages files

database.rls_scope: Two synthetic database identities and anonymous/disabled roles inside a rolled-back transaction; no real user records used

limitations: Physical iOS Safari and WebKit were not available in this environment.
Two genuine signed-in browser sessions were unavailable. Database RLS and two independent React workspaces with simulated sync transport were tested separately.
Scanned PDF has no OCR and is honestly marked no_text or partial.
Initial safe FB2 XML parsing remains synchronous and bounded by existing parser limits; subsequent extraction and indexing yield incrementally.
Cloud raw indexed text has a 64 MiB application budget per owner, separate from Supabase billing/storage quotas; no tariff was changed.

follow_up.change: Canonical cloud IDs replace already-promoted local entries in search, indexing and bibliography; a running local job cannot recreate old-ID metadata.
